options.name: label
options.description: Visible label (accessible name of the trigger or the value field).

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text, referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial color: hex, rgb(), or hsl() text (normalized to hex), or null.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; a hidden input submits the hex value.

options.name: required
options.description: A color must be chosen.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable the picker.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Show the value without allowing changes (thumbs stay focusable).

options.name: alpha
options.description: Show the opacity slider; the value becomes #rrggbbaa.

options.name: mode
options.description: Popup from a trigger button, or the panel in place.

options.name: presets
options.description: App-supplied preset swatches with optional spoken names.

options.name: recent
options.description: App-supplied recent colors (the app keeps the list).

options.name: eyeDropper
options.description: Offer the screen eyedropper where the browser has the EyeDropper API.

options.name: clearable
options.description: Show a clear button that sets the value to null.

options.name: contrastWith
options.description: Background color for the WCAG contrast hint (ratio and AA/AAA verdict).

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation of the hex value; return a message to mark it invalid.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icons for the error, eyedropper, and clear button.

options.name: format
options.description: Text format of the value field: 'hex', 'rgb', or 'hsl'.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages appear.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages and value text.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Set the value (color text or null; no event). Invalid text throws.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Close the popup; focus returns to the trigger by default.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the trigger (popup) or the area thumb (inline).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear validation state.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; an invalid update keeps the previous state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close the popup, abort a running eyedropper, and remove rendering, listeners, and the form registration.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: The value changes while dragging, with a key, or on any commit: { value, validity }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The value was committed (pointer release, key, swatch, typed text, eyedropper, clear): { value, validity }.

cssClasses.name: aui-color-picker__panel
cssClasses.description: Panel (dialog in the top layer, or group inline).

cssClasses.name: aui-color-picker__area | __area-thumb
cssClasses.description: Saturation and brightness area and its thumb.

cssClasses.name: aui-color-picker__contrast
cssClasses.description: Contrast hint (data-verdict: passAAA, passAA, passLarge, fail).
